verdict.rationale: Generated sound effects, ambient audio, or scene-matched music is a fair question for an AI video creation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only avatars, voice, lip-sync, dubbing, visual styles and prompt-to-video clips. Nothing documents generating SFX, ambience or music matched to scenes.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool
